limits: Fixed 20/40 development corpus, not independent acceptance or true Kimi answering.
Only owned Node process plus its worker counted; no Electron, observer or GPU/production process memory included.
Fresh process cold load; OS file cache may be warm; background machine load is not isolated.
RSS sampled every 20ms may miss shorter peaks; Windows PeakWorkingSet adds OS lifetime peak evidence.
Official E5 uses mean plus query/passage prefixes; official BGE uses CLS plus Chinese query instruction and no passage prefix. No pooling variant search was performed.
Unknown queries still retrieve a nearest candidate: cosine is not an answerability guarantee.

required: Versioned embedding model/revision/pooling/prefix/dtype for every vector
Full source-preserving reindex before querying candidate vectors
Never mix E5 384-dimensional vectors with BGE 512-dimensional vectors, or different same-dimensional models
Real packaged Electron all-process cold peak/idle checks against original 800/400 MiB gates
Independent Chinese/English proper-name and historical/unknown retrieval acceptance
